Strict literal-phrase matching passes 2 of 4 domain/module gates.
executor_conventions.H1-C2: Disambiguation is iterative: a uniquely resolved pair removes its API and its operation from every other candidate set; repeat to a fixpoint; remaining ties -> no proposal. Strict clause 4 leaves two ties (SO-CA-03, SO-PRD-01).
executor_conventions.H1-C3: Step 5 'clearly better' = at least two shared concepts and strictly more than every other domain.
executor_conventions.check3-stems: For RPC/SOAP paths without resource structure the qualifier is sought in the camel-split operation name by stem (clos-, post-, revers-).
